trans-unit.source: It used to be home to so many...
trans-unit.target: It used to be home to so many...

trans-unit.source: I got word it was destroyed by Dhaos, but had no idea it was this thoroughly.
trans-unit.target: I got word it was destroyed by Dhaos, but had no idea it was this thoroughly.

trans-unit.source: So now we have to get vengeance for Midgard.
trans-unit.target: So now we have to get vengeance for Midgard.

trans-unit.source: We can't let Dhaos run loose any longer!
trans-unit.target: We can't let Dhaos run loose any longer!
